name: dev.qrdx/qrdx
title: QRdx
description: QR codes and barcodes that scan: styled designs with a scan check, plus Wi-Fi and payment codes.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. A QRdx API key as Bearer qrdx_…, only to save themes and barcodes to your workspace, make AI QR art on its monthly AI art images or use a logo you uploaded. Every other tool works without it.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Design QR codes from any MCP client. design_qr checks the content and style, scores how well the code scans, adjusts the style until the score is Great, and returns SVG, PNG and a link to edit it in the playground. Payload tools build Wi-Fi, contact, email, SMS, location and bank-payment codes (Pix, SEPA, PayNow, PromptPay, VietQR). generate_barcode checks and renders EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, Code 128, Code 39, ITF-14, GS1-128, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. With a QRdx API key it can also save themes and barcodes to your workspace and paint codes into AI artwork that is checked to scan (generate_ai_art, on the workspace's monthly AI art images).
